analysis.title: INNIO (INIO): 3Q26 First Take: Large beat/raise, robust orders
key_insights: INIO reported 3Q26 segment EBITDA of $257 mn vs GS estimate $212 mn and consensus $214 mn, with stronger growth and margins in both segments.
Total segment revenue was $1,168 mn, +57.3% y/y, vs GS estimate of +39.0% and consensus of +40.7%.
Equipment revenue grew +86.3% y/y to $778 mn (GS est. +64.7%, consensus +69.6%). Services revenue grew +20.0% to $390 mn (GS est. +6.0%, consensus +3.6%).
Equipment orders were about $2.2 bn, +10% y/y, including data center orders of $1.795 bn, +55% y/y. The report cites a book-to-bill of 2.8x.
Equipment backlog reached a record of about $8 bn, +142% y/y.

INIO raised its FY26 revenue guide to $3.9-$4.0 bn from $3.8-$3.9 bn (GS $3.861 bn, consensus $3.878 bn) and its adjusted EBITDA guide to $780-$800 mn from $720-$740 mn (GS $740 mn, consensus $743 mn).
Services EBITDA margin was 31.7% vs GS 27.9% and consensus 28.5%. Equipment EBITDA margin was 17.1% vs GS 16.8% and consensus 16.7%.
GS rates INIO Buy with a 12-month price target of $35 (22x Q5-Q8 EBITDA), against a $16.63 close on 26 Oct 2026. GS expects the shares to outperform.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 beat on revenue and EBITDA, FY26 guidance raised above GS and consensus, and equipment backlog at a record of about $8 bn. GS expects the shares to outperform.

earnings_insights: INIO 3Q26 reported segment EBITDA $257 mn vs GS est $212 mn and consensus est $214 mn.
INIO 3Q26 reported segment revenue $1,168 mn (+57.3% y/y) vs GS est $1,032 mn and consensus est $1,045 mn.
INIO 3Q26 reported adjusted EBITDA $245 mn vs GS est $194 mn and consensus est $198 mn. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 21.0% vs GS est 18.8%.
INIO 3Q26 reported adjusted diluted EPS $0.15 vs GS est $0.11 and consensus est $0.12.

INIO raised FY26 guidance: revenue $3.9-$4.0 bn (prior $3.8-$3.9 bn) and adjusted EBITDA $780-$800 mn (prior $720-$740 mn). GS estimates are $3.861 bn and $740 mn. Consensus estimates are $3.878 bn and $743 mn.

GS forecasts for INIO: revenue $3,861 mn in 2026E, $5,329 mn in 2027E and $6,207 mn in 2028E. EBITDA is $740 mn, $1,150 mn and $1,440 mn. EPS is $0.35, $0.80 and $1.10. These GS estimates are dated before the 3Q26 print.
risk_factors: Slowdown in data center capex spending.
